functionalRequirements.title: User authentication
functionalRequirements.description: The system shall allow users to register, log in, reset passwords, and access protected account endpoints.

functionalRequirements.title: Doctor management
functionalRequirements.description: The system shall create, list, update, and delete doctor records.

functionalRequirements.title: Appointment management
functionalRequirements.description: The system shall create, list, update, and cancel appointments while enforcing authentication.

functionalRequirements.title: Medical records
functionalRequirements.description: The system shall create, retrieve, update, and enrich patient medical records and prescriptions.

functionalRequirements.title: Health endpoints
functionalRequirements.description: Each backend service and the API gateway shall expose a health endpoint for operational checks.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: API reliability
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Core API endpoints should return appropriate status codes and not crash on invalid input.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Security
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Protected routes should reject unauthorized requests and rely on authentication middleware.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Data validation
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Domain models should enforce required fields and reject malformed data.
